messages:
mike.dev: Hey team — I need temporary admin access to prod k8s cluster to inspect KV cache evictions and run a quick diag. Looks like node OOMs; need to exec into pod and dump /var/log/kvcache. ETA ~30m. Can I get break-glass for 1 hour? Ticket INF-4821
sara.sec: Hi @mike.dev — please paste the ticket link and a brief justification. Also confirm timeframe and who will audit the session. Policy: short-lived roles only (<=1h), session recording required. Don’t download raw logs with PII. :shield:
josh.sre: @mike.dev I can pair. If it’s kubectl exec + tailing logs I can approve provided you use bastion and we enable session recording. Post exact commands you’ll run.
infra-bot: check: no active incidents; last deploy 2025-06-12 03:14 UTC; cluster capacity: 72% used. (automated)
emma.eng: If you need help with redaction, I can jump in. Use `rg` + `sed` or the /opt/tools/logs-redact tool per docs.
sara.sec: Approval steps: 1) create short-lived Okta role, 2) request sudo through infra-console with reason INF-4821, 3) use bastion -> kubectl with recording. Do NOT copy logs to personal devices. Use `logs-redact --pii-scan` for anything exported. Docs: https://redwood.internal/security/logs-redaction
mike.dev: Ticket link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4821 — justification: investigate KV cache OOM evictions causing +5% p50 latency. Plan: exec into pod, run redaction and inspect. Requesting 45 minutes.
sara.sec: Good. @josh.sre will you approve for 45m? Also add @emma.eng as observer.
josh.sre: Approved for 45m. Ensure 2FA and we need a post-session note. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: role-request INF-4821: pending approval from josh.sre
mike.dev: Requesting Okta role now. Will post bastion session link when started.
mike.dev: Session started: https://bastion.redwood.ai/session/abcd1234 — recording enabled. Doing `kubectl exec -it kv-01 -- /bin/bash` now. I will only run redaction command and inspect logs, no downloads.
sara.sec: Noted. For audit: paste the kubectl commands you run in-thread.
mike.dev: `kubectl exec -it kv-01 -n prod -- /bin/bash -c "cat /var/log/kvcache.log | /opt/tools/logs-redact --pii-scan > /tmp/kv-cache-redacted.log"`
emma.eng: Watching. If you need to persist, upload the redacted file to secure S3: `s3://redwood-secure/INF-4821/` with KMS CMK.
josh.sre: Reminder: session will auto-revoke at the 45m mark. Confirm when you finish so we can manually revoke early if needed.
mike.dev: Done. Session ended. Uploaded redacted log: s3://redwood-secure/INF-4821/kv-cache-redacted.log
sara.sec: Verified upload and that audit log shows session recording. Access revoked. Please add a short post-action note in INF-4821 with commands run and observations. Closing approval. :lock:
